comment: Shared tag query param cases: wildcard validation, family LIKE pattern, and bare reserved prefix hint. Both Next (src/lib/query.test.ts) and Go (faas/internal/query) load this file. Field `pattern` is the expected LIKE pattern for the tag filter; `hint` is the expected response hint (empty = none).

cases.name: bare-wildcard-rejected
cases.error: invalid tag query "*": use a valid tag name or a family pattern "tag=review:*" (a single "*" at the end, prefix must be non-empty)

cases.name: mid-wildcard-rejected
cases.error: invalid tag query "re*view": use a valid tag name or a family pattern "tag=review:*" (a single "*" at the end, prefix must be non-empty)

cases.name: trailing-star-no-colon-rejected
cases.error: invalid tag query "work*": use a valid tag name or a family pattern "tag=review:*" (a single "*" at the end, prefix must be non-empty)

cases.name: double-wildcard-rejected
cases.error: invalid tag query "re*vi*": use a valid tag name or a family pattern "tag=review:*" (a single "*" at the end, prefix must be non-empty)

cases.name: wildcard-with-trailing-content-rejected
cases.error: invalid tag query "review:*:x": use a valid tag name or a family pattern "tag=review:*" (a single "*" at the end, prefix must be non-empty)

cases.name: bare-reserved-review-hint
cases.hint: Use "tag=review:*" to match review records (the bare tag "review" is reserved and never stored)

cases.name: bare-reserved-todo-hint
cases.hint: Use "tag=todo:*" to match todo records (the bare tag "todo" is reserved and never stored)

cases.name: bare-reserved-transaction-entry-hint
cases.hint: Use "tag=transaction_entry:*" to match transaction_entry records (the bare tag "transaction_entry" is reserved and never stored)

cases.name: trailing-star-requires-colon-double
cases.error: invalid tag query "a:*:*": use a valid tag name or a family pattern "tag=review:*" (a single "*" at the end, prefix must be non-empty)
